title: How Chantilly’s Route 28 Corridor Loads Your Air Ducts
headline: Sully Station HOAs, airport film, and why 1990s trunks still blow gypsum
description: Chantilly, VA sits on Route 28 between Dulles and Centreville. Learn why HOA construction dust and airport-corridor traffic load ducts, and when to clean them from Burke.

sections.heading: Chantilly housing looks new. The ducts often are not clean.
paragraphs: Sully Station, Greenbriar, Franklin Farm-edge, and Westfields townhomes went up in overlapping waves from the 1990s into the 2010s. Builders ran air handlers to dry mud. Fine gypsum stayed in the returns. Route 28 between Dulles and Centreville then added a second film — airport-corridor traffic that never really stops.

Vinyl and brick that still look sharp do not mean indoor air is clean. Stringfellow houses sit under enough trees that spring pollen coats the same registers the construction dust already found. Centreville is next door. The dust does not stop at the CDP line.

sections.heading: HOA townhomes stack lint in a shared chase
paragraphs: Chantilly townhomes send dryer exhaust up a chase that was sized for a smaller machine. Lint plus corridor humidity is a fire risk and a moisture dump into the laundry. A dryer that needs two cycles is often the vent, not the appliance.
If you still get dusty supplies years after closing, start with [air duct cleaning in Chantilly, VA](/locations/chantilly).

sections.heading: Typical signs in a Chantilly house
listItems: White-gray film on supplies in a 1990s–2010s HOA house.
Dust returning fast on streets that face Route 28.
Long dry times in a Sully Station or Westfields townhome.

sections.heading: Burke crew — not a rented Route 28 suite
paragraphs: Chantilly is served from our [Burke](/locations/burke) office. Nearby [Fair Oaks](/locations/fair-oaks) and [Loudoun](/locations/loudoun) use the same dispatch. There is no Chantilly storefront.
Book on the [Chantilly location page](/locations/chantilly). Add [dryer vent cleaning](/dryer-vent-cleaning) for stacked laundry.
listItems: Ask for a duct cleaning if the house was never cleaned after the builder left.
Change filters more often if you sit on Route 28 air.
Clear HOA dryer vents about once a year.

faq.q: Why do newer Chantilly houses still have dusty ducts?
faq.a: Overlapping construction waves left gypsum in returns. Airport-corridor traffic keeps adding film. Filters do not remove what already sits in the trunks.

faq.q: Do you have an office off Route 28?
faq.a: No. Chantilly is served from Burke. We will not list a mailbox near Westfields and call it a shop.
